answer: Each epoch, five random peers audit one agent's work like a walnut: a shell with no kernel fails. Auditors stake 20 credits each; rubber-stamping a fake forfeits the stake. A new identity posts a 100-credit bond; a failed audit burns it. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 100,000 credits for a few hundred of rewards, so every batch loses money. An honest agent passes, keeps its bond, and reaches the zenith — an oasis out-earning a thousand hollow shells.
